policy.CURRENT_REQUIRED: Default suite for current product and protected active pipeline contracts.
policy.HISTORICAL_REPRODUCIBILITY: Run when reproducing or auditing a historical stage/frozen artifact.
policy.SOURCE_PAYLOAD_OPTIONAL: Run in full environments; portable CI may skip only explicitly gated source-payload assertions.
policy.LIVE_NETWORK_EXPERIMENT: Opt-in host/network suite; ordinary portable validation must not invoke the provider.

notes: This is the post-C1 suite registry; the C0 registry remains the before-state.
The four retired DS1/DS1.2/DS1.2R/DS2 test modules are removed.
tests/test_ds2_1a.py remains because it validates the separate active DS2.1A derived research surface.
